_doc: Boarding (docs/BOARDING.md, scripts/board/). The sites the soldier explores on foot: a derelict, an abandoned station, a pirate nest, or the wreck of a ship you beat. All numbers are here. kinds: per site kind (the `board` effect's kind): bands (the layouts, one picked per site: R is a band of rooms, C a corridor between them), interior (the widest band, in cells), room_h and room_w (a room's inside size, [min, max]), hull (the enemy-table faction whose hull ops shape the outline; '' = the region's faction, else clans), weights of the room purposes (airlock is always one room, picked from the rooms at either end of a band), min/max (rooms of a purpose a site has at least/most), hack and card (how many doors are locked, [min, max]: a hack door opens after holding E for `hack_s`; a card door wants the keycard that lies in a container of a room the airlock reaches without it), loop (the chance a pair of side-by-side rooms get a door between them), emergency (the chance a room has a red emergency light), prop_mult (x the props of every room), loot_mult (x the counts of every roll), locked_bonus (x the props of a room behind a locked door), blueprints (the chance of 0, 1, 2 blueprints in the site), logs ([min, max] derelict logs on offer), bonus (outcomes added to every container table of the kind), names (pool for the site's name). props: the site-only layer. size [w, h] (a pallet lies along a wall: it turns), blocks (the soldier cannot walk through), loot (a container: it has contents), rolls ([min, max] rolls of its table), hold (seconds of holding E to open it), table (a table that is not the room's purpose's), bonus (outcomes added to the table of this prop: lockers and cabinets can hold a mod of Mk I or II: item mod_low), bp (weight of holding a blueprint), log (weight of holding a log). rooms: per purpose, the props it gets as [{prop, n: [min, max]}] and the tint it is drawn with; bp is the weight of the room for a blueprint. tables: weighted outcomes as in data/debris.json `roll` ({weight, item, count: [min, max]}); item is a material, an item or a part (cargo), credits or fuel. blueprint: weights of the recipe levels (fab_level 1-3) by the campaign's tier. A blueprint slot becomes a recipe the ship does not know when the container is opened, else `fallback`. Stage B3: people (who is aboard, see its own _doc), marks (the discoveries) and themes (the look and the loot of a site by region) have their own _doc. Playtest 4.1: air (a room has a pressure, boarding.json `kinds` may give a kind `air`, else 1; `gear` says which body gear is sealed against it, see air.gd), ship (the wreck of a ship you beat is boarded as that ship, see wreck_site.gd) and foe_loot (what a beaten foe leaves) have their own _doc.

derelict.flavor: You seal your suit, cycle the lock and step across. Her lights are out. Yours are not much better.

station.flavor: The old docking collar takes your hull with a groan. The corridor beyond is dark, and a long way from anything.

nest.flavor: You go in quiet. Somebody lives here, or did until very recently.

wreck.flavor: The cutters have opened her flank already. You climb through the gap, into the dark.

cleared_text: Every locker, crate and drawer is open. There is nothing left aboard worth the air.

combat._doc: On foot, stage B2 (scripts/board/arms.gd, foes.gd, party.gd). ammo_item: the cargo item a magazine is loaded from. mag, reload_s, spread_deg: by hand weapon class (data/hand_weapons.json); melee and tools have no magazine. hand_items: the cargo items that are hand weapons and the weapon each stands for (found in loot, Q swaps between the two carried; the plasma rifle of the events is the Gatekeeper's Lance). foe_drop: the chance a beaten foe whose weapon has an item here leaves it in the hold (foes.gd). hit_r: the radius of a body a ray hits (cells); prop_stop: the chance a prop a ray enters stops it (cover). noise_gun and noise_swing: cells within which a shot or a swing alerts every foe. flash_range, self_range: how far the flashlight and the small light round the soldier reach (the view draws them). down_hp: the share of his health the soldier wakes with; down_text is what the screen says. door_near: how close a body must come to open a door. leave_quiet_s: seconds no foe may have noticed anyone before the Leave button (L) works; leave_fade_s: its fade; leave_hunted: what the greyed button says. revive_s and revive_hp: holding E by a downed crewman (the soldier or a follower) and the share of health they get up with. hack_sentry_s and hack_back_deg: holding E behind a sentry, the angle off its facing that counts as behind. party_max: crew who can come along. follower_ammo_min: a follower whose weapon has a magazine boards with a copy of the soldier's spare rounds, at least this many (scripts/board/party.gd). follow_near and follow_far: a follower walks to the soldier from further than far and stops within near. sight: how far a foe sees, in cells: dark (always), red (a room with an emergency light), lit (in the beam of the flashlight, or the soldier is lit); notice_s is how long it takes to be sure of what it sees (less when close). hollow: the Hollow falling while the soldier is aboard (count of hollow_touched, the toast, the banner).
combat.down_text: You come to at the airlock.

hollow.banner: The Hollow is here. Get out.

kit._doc: Loadouts (B4, scripts/board/kit.gd). The airlock's loadout screen sets, for the soldier and each follower, weapon_slots weapons (their species' sidearm, or a hand weapon of the hold: combat.hand_items), one body gear of `bodies` and mod_slots mods (data/mods.json). What a person wears has left the hold, and goes back when it is taken off. A follower fights with the first weapon they carry.

looks._doc: What body gear looks like on a person (scripts/crew/person_drawer.gd). mark: the glyph of its icon (board_cards.gd _body_icon); art: the id of its sprites in art/gear/ (made for the human rig; a species whose rig has the human's anchors wears them, any other rig gets the flat shapes below). The flat look, the fallback (draw_gear): shapes over the body and under the head. Source px (16 to a cell) in the body's frame: x is the person's right, y is back (forward is -y), the middle is between the shoulders; the pieces turn with the body. color: the main tone, dark and light: the edge and the highlight (from color when missing). pieces, drawn in order: shape (circle: at, r; rect: at (top-left), size; ring: at, r, an outline), tone (main, dark, light or a #hex; main when missing), alpha, edge (true: an outline in the dark tone), over_head (true: drawn over the head, as a helmet is).

armor._doc: The share of the damage a person takes aboard, by the body gear they wear (1.0 = none). The EVA suit and the heat suit take no damage off, but they are sealed (`gear`): their line says so (kit.gd body_line).

gear._doc: Body gear against bad air on foot (scripts/board/air.gd). sealed: a person who wears it breathes in a room whose pressure is under crew.json air.breath_ok (they take no no-air damage there, and a follower in it follows into an airless room). Suits are sealed; plain armour is not. Anyone with the vacuum_walk trait, no breath (o2_use 0) or the `suit` trait is as safe as a sealed suit.

rigger_harness.line: Repairs 30% faster aboard; hacks doors 40% faster on foot.

firefighter_coat.line: Half fire damage; puts out fires 50% faster. Lighter than the Salamander Suit.

medic_sash.line: A small heal aura in its room aboard; revives 40% faster on foot.

chitin_plate.line: Melee attackers take 4 damage back; walks 5% slower.

spore_mantle.line: Slowly heals allies near you on foot and aboard.

prism_cloak.line: Deflects 35% of energy bolts on foot; ion hits do 40% less aboard.

tank_harness.line: Its own air tank: sealed, and thin air hurts far less aboard.

forge_apron.line: Immune to fire; a hot room does not slow you.

traders_coat.line: Shops pay 15% more for what you sell while you are aboard.

scrap_gauntlets.line: Melee hits 35% harder; wrecks give 50% more scrap.

flare._doc: The flare gun's flare (B4): it sticks where it lands and burns burn_s seconds, and lights `radius` cells round it. A burning flare counts as an emergency light for what a foe sees (foes.gd), so it lights a room for both sides. Only the soldier's and his crew's flare guns leave one; at most `max` burn at once (the oldest goes out).

bolts._doc: What a shot looks like (B4, scripts/board/bolts.gd, board_view.gd). The logic is hitscan; the view flies a bolt from the muzzle to the hit point at `speed` cells a second and shows the hit when it arrives. A look is built in layers: default, then the weapon's class, then its culture (data/hand_weapons.json), then the weapon's own id; each layer sets only the keys it changes. A foe's shot uses `foe` (by foe kind; a hacked sentry fires in the colour of the soldier's weapon). Keys: color and core (the glow and the hot centre), len (cells), width (px), speed (cells a second), light_r (cells the bolt's light reaches) and energy, kind (bolt, beam: the whole line at once, held for `hold` seconds; arc: a jittering line; flame: a short flickering cone; flare: a slow shell that sticks; swing: a melee arc, no light), impact (spark, slug, arc, flame, flare, none), shake (screen shake in px of a shot), sound (the sound id of the shot; none = shot_<class>), jitter (an arc's wobble, cells). max_lights: bolt and flare lights at once (the oldest drops). shadow_lights: how many of them cast shadows from the walls at once (the burning flares, then the newest bolts; a shadow costs far more than the light). scorch_s: seconds a scorch mark on a wall takes to fade. A bolt of an Overcharge Coil is wider and brighter by the mod's `size` (data/mods.json).

enemies._doc: The foes (scripts/board/foes.gd). hp; weapon: the hand weapon drawn in their hands (art); attack: damage, rate (a second) and range (cells; a melee foe's reach) of one hit; inacc: the half-width in radians of the error of an aimed shot (x1.3 against a target that is moving); speed: x the walk speed of a person (3 cells a second); fov_deg and dark: the sight cone and how far it sees with no light on the target (data combat.sight); hold: the share of its range at which a shooter stops to fire; flee_below: the hp share under which it runs; cover: it takes cover behind props; patrol: stand or wander; alert_r: cells within which a foe that notices calls its mates; look: the palette it is drawn with; lines: what a polite one says on noticing you (a toast). The sentry (turret) turns at turn rad/s and sees a cone of cone_deg; it can be hacked (combat.hack_sentry_s). sealed: the foe wears a suit (or needs no breath), so a room with no air does not hurt it (air.gd; a crew member of a beaten ship is sealed only by their own gear, wreck_site.gd). The crawler lives in the vents: emerge (cells within which it comes out), lunge {range, speed, time, damage, cooldown}, hide_s (seconds in a light before it goes back).

hollow_touched.name: Hollow-touched
lines: Hello. You are not on the list.
We are so glad you came.
Do not run. It is rude.

foe._doc: A foe on foot is a real race (scripts/board/foes.gd pick_species). Only the kinds listed true in `kinds` are people and get a race; the rest (sentry, crawler) are not. The race follows from where it stands, on its own dice (the site seed and the foe's id; the fight's are not shifted): a foe taken from a beaten ship's crew, or a person who turned on you, keeps its species; in a section of a race-built station, `section_share` of them are that section's race; else the race of the ship style of the site's faction, else the region's own race (its home_species) at the region's race_share (shipgen RACE_SHARE when it has none), else the people species of the site's theme (people.species). A drone species is never picked. The numbers, weapon, loot and gear stay the kind's: the race is the body, the name line (label of the race's ship style, else the species name, then the kind's name) and the traits of the systems that already run on foot (air, heat).

spawn._doc: Who stands where (foes.gd spawn). Per site kind: count [min, max] of foes, mix = weights of the foe kinds. A foe stands on a free spot of a room picked by room_weights (the airlock's own room never), at least min_from_airlock cells from where the soldier arrives. In a place the Hollow already holds, hollow_share of them are hollow_touched instead. A wreck holds its surviving crew (the `crew` of the board effect, at most crew_max). crawler: the chance a site has one, and how many vents [min, max] it has (floor cells by a wall where it hides).

ship._doc: The wreck of a ship you beat is boarded as that ship (scripts/board/wreck_site.gd): its grid, doors and holes (a cell shot away is open to space and no body walks out of it), its rooms, its parts as props (`part` blocks like a wall; a part that was destroyed is a scrap heap), the crew who died aboard as bodies where they died, and the crew still on their feet after a win as foes where they stood (their species' foe type: `foe`, default and by species; they keep their hp share; a captured ship has none). Every room keeps the pressure it had when the fight ended. purpose: the room purpose (a key of `rooms`) of the family of the parts in a room; the purpose with most parts wins, ties by `order`; a room with no part is a corridor when it is no more than `narrow` cells across, else `bare`. hatch: the airlock is a room on the hull edge whose outer wall holds a 2-wide hatch; it is picked on a long side of the ship, nearest the ship's middle (`thick` is the most wall cells between the floor and space). lights: the chance of a red emergency light in a room. Only a ship rebuilt from a saved fight is boarded this way: an older save's wreck (no ship stored) is a generated site.

foe_loot._doc: What a beaten foe leaves (scripts/board/loot.gd, foes.gd): a body on its cells, a container opened with E like a locker (hold seconds). Always `ammo` rounds of hand_ammo ([min, max]) and `credits` ([min, max]); the foe's weapon (as an item, combat.hand_items) at combat.foe_drop; and, at `extra`, one more find: a mod (data/mods.json, Mk I or II; Mk III for `elite` kinds) or a piece of body gear from `gear` ({weight, item}), half and half by `mod_share`. Per foe kind; `default` is used for a kind not listed. Strong kinds (sentry, crawler, Hollow-touched) roll more. The counts grow with the tier as every container's do (loot.gd TIER_GROWTH).

people._doc: The people aboard (scripts/board/people.gd, docs/BOARDING.md stage B3). kinds: per site kind, `count` (the chance of 0, 1, 2 people, keys as `blueprints`) and `roles` (weights; a nest holds only captives, a wreck's survivors fight on foot, see spawn). roles: name; hp; weapon (the hand weapon drawn in their hands, '' for none); look (the palette they are drawn with, a muted one, never a foe's); rooms (weights of the room purposes they stand in, else `rooms`); hostile (the foe kind they become when they turn on you or are shot: `npc_hostile`); sits (drawn leaning, not standing). species: the weights of a person's species when the theme has none (the species are crew species: one who joins is a crew member of it). names: the pool of a person's name when the theme has none. rooms: the default weights of the rooms they stand in. min_from_airlock and apart: cells from where the soldier arrives and from another person or foe. talk_reach: cells within which E talks. face_r: cells within which a person turns to face the soldier. hollow_mult: x the weight of a role in a place the Hollow holds. shop: items (rolled from the tables of the site, by the room the person stands in), markup (x the cargo value of a stack, never the sale price), tries (rolls to find that many different items). reveal: weights of the container picks of `npc_reveal`. follow: the sidearm and health of a person who follows (`npc_follow`) until the soldier leaves. leave_s: seconds a person walking away has to get there before they are gone. fight: `site_fight` ambush, cells from the soldier [min, max].
people.after: %s has said what there is to say.

marks._doc: Site discoveries (Site._place_marks; the events of type boarding_site). count: per site kind, [min, max] marked spots; weights: the kinds of spot (a `terminal` or a `body` in a room, or the `room` itself: a strange one). Stepping into a marked room for the first time (and no foe on the hunt) opens one `boarding_site` event, once. The soldier sees a faint note-mark on a marked prop while it is unread.

themes._doc: Site themes by region (scripts/board/themes.gd, docs/BOARDING.md stage B3): what a place looks like and holds by whose space it is in. The theme of a visit is the first whose `regions` name the region (its id or its events tag), else the first whose `factions` name the region's faction; a place the Hollow holds is `hollow`; a region of none of them has no theme (the plain site). It is kept in the sector's memory of the site, so a later visit is the same place. name; wash and wash_mix (the colour the room tints are pulled toward, and how far); colors (per prop: [fill, edge] it is drawn with); rooms (props added to the rooms of a purpose, as the `rooms` of this file: the same {prop, n}); loot.tilt (x the weight of a table outcome by item id, in every table of the site) and loot.logs (more derelict logs on offer); foes: mix (x the weight of a foe kind), add (kind -> its weight as a share of the whole base mix: 0.2 is one foe in six more), count (x the number of foes); npc: count (x the chance a site has any person), roles (x the weight of a role); species (weights of a person's species) and people (the pool of their names); emergency (x the chance a room has a red light); names: per site kind, a list for the site's name ({n} is a number 1 to 19).

beds._doc: Beds on foot (scripts/board/beds.gd): a bed blocks like a pallet (size [w, h], turned along a side wall) and is not a container. Hold E by a working bed and the soldier heals heal_hp_s a second (the ship's bed heals 5, its medbay 15); hold E by a hurt follower near a free working bed (as long as a revive) and they lie down on it and heal until full, or until a foe hunts the party. One person to a bed. Nobody heals while a foe is on the hunt: `refuse` is said. A generated site's medbay has count [min, max] beds by kind, each working at `works` (mostly broken); a module station's come from its type and state (data/station_modules.json); a beaten ship's bed parts are beds, working at `works`. reach: cells from a bed's middle within which E uses it.
beds.refuse: Not with them on your heels.

loot_theme._doc: Loot that fits the room (scripts/board/loot.gd). A container's first roll is today's: its table's weights pick an outcome, and the outcome's tier (common and rare materials, part, gear, weapon, ammo, credits, mod, special) is what the roll gave. Only then, in a room whose purpose has tags here (`rooms`), the item is picked again within that tier, each outcome's weight x `mult` when its tags meet the room's: so every tier keeps its share and the items that fit the room come up more often. tiers: what an item counts as when its kind does not say (tier_of in loot.gd: credits, mod, a part (components.json), a hand weapon (combat.hand_items), ammo (items.json kind ammo), body gear (`gear`), a material by its rarity: common, else rare; the rest special). Tags: `families` (a part's family -> tags), `items` (an item or a material -> tags); a recipe has the tags of what it makes, so a blueprint found in a room favours recipes that fit it the same way, among those equally wanted.

regional._doc: Race gear in its region's lockers (scripts/board/loot.gd table_for): region id -> {item: x the weight of that outcome in every table of a site in that region}. The race items sit in the tables at a small weight everywhere; this lifts them at home.

actives._doc: The active of a piece of body gear (gear.<item>.active), used on foot with the G key (scripts/board/gear_active.gd): name; cooldown (seconds until it can be used again); and its own numbers. dash: the soldier jumps `cells` cells the way he aims over `time` seconds (it stops at a wall). brace: for `time` seconds he takes `share` x the damage. patch: he and every ally within `reach` cells heal `share` of their health. The cooldown shows on the soldier's card.

wear._doc: Who wears what (scripts/board/wear.gd). foe: per foe kind, `chance` of wearing body gear and the weighted `items` it picks from; a foe in a region with race gear (`regional`) wears that item instead with `home` chance. energy_foes: the foe kinds whose shots a Prism Cloak may deflect (gear.<item>.deflect). npc: per role, as foe; a person of a species with an item in `race_item` wears it with `race` chance (before the role's items). Worn gear is drawn, gives the foe its armour, and may be on its body: `drop` is the chance a beaten foe's body holds the gear it wore (loot.gd; the old `extra` roll stays). crew: the gear a beaten ship's crew wear on the wreck, by species (`race_item`) with `chance`.
